nodes.label: Fuzz
nodes.description: Transistor-style fuzz with selectable device chemistry, bias starvation, and source-impedance interaction.

realization_axes.label: Device
realization_axes.description: Transistor chemistry. Germanium is softer and more temperature-dependent; silicon is harder and more stable.

realization_axes.label: Oversampling
realization_axes.description: Four-times oversampling trades reported latency for reduced aliasing.

parameters.label: Fuzz
parameters.description: Nonlinear intensity — how hard the pair is driven into its fuzz region.

parameters.label: Bias Starve
parameters.description: Starves the bias supply, producing gating, splatter, and note dropout.

parameters.label: Source Impedance
parameters.description: Impedance of the source feeding the input, which loads the circuit and changes both gain and brightness.

parameters.label: Output
parameters.description: Output trim applied after the nonlinearity.

parameters.label: Mix
parameters.description: Blend between the dry input and the fuzz output.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.description: Slow deterministic component drift, modelling a circuit that is not perfectly stable.

nodes.label: Saturator
nodes.description: Memoryless waveshaping with four harmonic curves and a construction-time anti-aliasing policy.

realization_axes.label: Shape
realization_axes.description: Selects the fixed transfer curve and harmonic character.

realization_axes.label: Alias Policy
realization_axes.description: Selects antiderivative anti-aliasing, two-times oversampling, or the raw curve.

parameters.label: Drive
parameters.description: Input gain applied before the transfer curve.

parameters.label: Bias
parameters.description: Offsets the transfer curve to introduce asymmetric harmonics.

parameters.label: Pre Tone
parameters.description: Sets the pre-emphasis corner; zero disables the stage.

parameters.label: Mix
parameters.description: Blends the latency-aligned dry and saturated signals.

parameters.label: Output Trim
parameters.description: Applies gain after the wet/dry blend.

parameters.label: Tone Tracking
parameters.description: Makes the de-emphasis corner track the pre-emphasis corner.

parameters.label: De-emphasis
parameters.description: Sets the independent post-shaper de-emphasis corner when tracking is off.

parameters.label: Pre Boost
parameters.description: Boosts the pre-emphasis stage before nonlinear shaping.

nodes.label: Analog VCF
nodes.description: Four analog-inspired voltage-controlled filter voicings with panel-style cutoff, resonance, modulation, and input drive.

realization_axes.label: Voicing
realization_axes.description: Circuit family whose calibration, resonance, and saturation behavior define the filter.

parameters.label: Cutoff
parameters.description: Panel cutoff position after the selected voicing's calibrated frequency law.

parameters.label: Cutoff Modulation
parameters.description: Musical pitch offset applied to the cutoff in octaves.

parameters.label: Resonance
parameters.description: Emphasis at the cutoff, extending into self-oscillating behavior for the selected circuit.

parameters.label: Drive
parameters.description: Input drive into the filter's nonlinear stages.

nodes.label: Character Delay
nodes.description: Stereo wet-only delay spanning clean, vintage digital, tape, bucket-brigade, and diffused echoes.

realization_axes.label: Character
realization_axes.description: Delay-line and coloration topology fixed when the node is built.

parameters.label: Time Offset
parameters.description: Right-channel delay-time multiplier for stereo offset.

parameters.label: Feedback
parameters.description: Amount of delayed signal returned to the delay input.

parameters.label: Crossfeed
parameters.description: Amount of each channel fed into the opposite channel's feedback path.

parameters.label: Character
parameters.description: Intensity of the selected delay topology's coloration.

parameters.label: Modulation Rate
parameters.description: Rate of delay-time instability within the selected character.

parameters.label: Duck
parameters.description: Reduces delayed output while the input is active.

parameters.label: Freeze
parameters.description: Holds the current delay contents in a sustaining feedback loop.

parameters.label: Reverse
parameters.description: Reads completed delay segments in reverse.

nodes.label: Distortion
nodes.description: Circuit-modeled diode distortion with selectable clipping topology and antialiasing quality.

realization_axes.label: Topology
realization_axes.description: Whether the diode pair clips to ground or sits in an amplifier feedback loop.

realization_axes.label: Oversampling
realization_axes.description: Antialiasing quality and its corresponding fixed latency.

parameters.label: Symmetry
parameters.description: Offsets positive and negative clipping thresholds for asymmetric harmonics.

parameters.label: Diode
parameters.description: Diode material and its characteristic forward-voltage curve.

parameters.label: Pre Tone
parameters.description: Tone-shaping frequency before the clipping stage.

parameters.label: Pre Gain
parameters.description: Input trim before the pre-tone and drive stages.

parameters.label: Post Tone
parameters.description: Tone-shaping frequency after the clipping stage.

parameters.label: Tone Mix
parameters.description: Blend between the pre- and post-clipping tone paths.

parameters.label: Output
parameters.description: Output trim after distortion and tone shaping.
